title: How was your weekend?
goal_hi: Monday ko weekend ke baare me past simple me baat karna.

pattern.note_hi: Weekend khatam ho gaya, isliye was. Aaj ke liye How is your day?

examples.en: It was good, thanks. How was yours?
examples.hi: Achha tha, thanks. Aapka kaisa tha?

examples.en: It was busy, but I enjoyed it.
My weekend was quiet. I stayed home.
examples.hi: Mera weekend shaant tha. Main ghar par ruka.

examples.en: The traffic was bad on Sunday.

words.example_en: I slept a lot over the weekend.
I spend Sunday with my family.
words.example_hi: Main Sunday parivaar ke saath bitaata hoon.

words.example_en: There was heavy traffic this morning.

words.example_hi: Monday ko main thaka hua feel karta hoon.

words.example_en: I relax at home on Sunday.
words.example_hi: Main Sunday ko ghar par aaram karta hoon.

dialogue.title: Monday weekend catch-up
dialogue.context_hi: Monday morning, desk ke paas. Colleague se weekend ki baat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was good, thanks. I stayed home with my family.
lines.hi: Achha tha, thanks. Main parivaar ke saath ghar par raha.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. There was a lot of traffic and we went out on Sunday.
lines.hi: Khaas nahi. Bahut traffic tha aur Sunday ko hum bahar gaye.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh no. So you're tired today?
lines.hi: Oh no. Toh aaj thake hue ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A little. I just want to relax this evening.
lines.hi: Thoda. Aaj shaam bas aaram karna hai.

sound_focus.tip_hi: was = /wɒz/ short, were = /wɜːr/. 'It was good' me was ko lamba mat kholo.

scenario.setting_hi: Monday desk chat me colleague aapka weekend poochta hai.

turns.hint_hi: Achha tha — thanks ke saath batao.
Sunday ko family ke ghar gaye the.
turns.model_en: I went to my family's place on Sunday.
Yes, there was a lot of traffic.

turns.hint_hi: Thoda thaka hua ho, shaam ko relax karna hai.
turns.model_en: A little, so I want to relax this evening.
